theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.symbol_mul {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] [IsDomain A] {P Q : QuantumTorus A} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
symbol (P * Q) = symbol P * symbol Q

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.topDeg_mul {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] [IsDomain A] {P Q : QuantumTorus A} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
topDeg (P * Q) = ↑(leadDeg P + leadDeg Q)

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.coeffAt_mul_eq_zero_of_lt {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] {P Q : QuantumTorus A} {m n k : ℤ} (hP : topDeg P ≤ ↑m) (hQ : topDeg Q ≤ ↑n) (hk : m + n < k) :
coeffAt (P * Q) k = 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.coeffAt_mul_add {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] {P Q : QuantumTorus A} {m n : ℤ} (hP : topDeg P ≤ ↑m) (hQ : topDeg Q ≤ ↑n) :
coeffAt (P * Q) (m + n) = coeffAt P m * Multiplicative.ofAdd m • coeffAt Q n

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.toAdd_le_of_mem_support {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] {P : QuantumTorus A} {m : ℤ} (hP : topDeg P ≤ ↑m) {x : Ldeg} (hx : x ∈ SkewMonoidAlgebra.support P) :
Multiplicative.toAdd x ≤ m

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.leadCoeff_ne_zero {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] {P : QuantumTorus A} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
leadCoeff P ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.topDeg_eq_leadDeg {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] {P : QuantumTorus A} (hP : P ≠ 0) :

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.support_nonempty_of_ne_zero {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] {P : QuantumTorus A} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
(expSupport P).Nonempty

theorem QOU.Machinery.QuantumTorus.leadDeg_monomial {A : Type u_1} [CommRing A] [MulSemiringAction Ldeg A] {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
